northStar: Determine whether Cloudflare can turn an existing OpenAPI API into a safe native WebMCP interface without changing the API implementation.
proven: One explicitly enabled OpenAPI GET operation became a native read-only WebMCP tool in Chrome 151.
The native call reached the unchanged fixture API and changed visible page state.
An operation without x-webmcp-enabled true was absent from native discovery and the generated call route.
An external same-origin bootstrap preserves script-src self and passes native discovery and invocation.
Cloudflare can generate a same-origin companion document for a JSON-only API, and that document can publish and call native tools.
falsified: Inline script injection works on a page with script-src self.
A JSON API document can itself publish native WebMCP tools.
notProven: CSP policies that require a nonce or hash and do not allow self
Request fidelity beyond path and query GET
nextAction: Run a corpus of OpenAPI input schemas through native Chrome registration and discovery.
